highlights.title: Replies start with the bot's own words
highlights.text: A reply no longer flashes a line about which model or bot kwant picked before it starts. kwant still picks the same way; that note now stays in kwant's log.

highlights.title: Reply cards appear in one piece
highlights.text: A bot's reply card no longer shows up empty for a moment when a reply starts, when the next bot takes over or after Allow once. The card and its words now appear together.

fixes: The Copy button on code blocks now shows a focus ring when you reach it with the keyboard.
Switching kwant to another Telegram bot now clears the buttons on the old bot's cards.
Line chart date labels no longer run into each other at the right edge.
Switching Telegram bots now clears the old bot's buttons even when Telegram asks kwant to slow down.
At a handoff in a team run, the next bot's name now appears together with its own words.
